historical_pricing.summaries.Definition

Creates a definition containing a summary of the specified historical pricing events.

Available as lseg.data.content.historical_pricing.summaries.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    universe: StrStrings,
    interval: str | Intervals = None,
    start: OptDateTime = None,
    end: OptDateTime = None,
    adjustments: OptAdjustments = None,
    sessions: OptMarketSession = None,
    count: OptInt = None,
    fields: StrStrings = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe StrStrings Yes Single instrument or list of instruments.
interval str | Intervals No None Predefined interval for filtering historical pricing events.
start OptDateTime No None Start time for the events query.
end OptDateTime No None End time for the events query.
adjustments OptAdjustments No None Single adjustment type or list of adjustment types to apply CORAX (Corporate Actions) events or exchange/manual corrections to the historical time series data.
sessions OptMarketSession No None Market session durations, such as pre-market session, normal market session and post-market session.
count OptInt No None The maximum number of rows to return.
fields StrStrings No None The list of fields to return.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None Additional parameters to apply to the request.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the client file store to retrieve the previously defined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> TypeData

Parameters

Example

from lseg.data.content.historical_pricing import summaries
definition_summaries = summaries.Definition("EUR")
response = definition_summaries.get_data()
